name: Doria Flint
description: Adult master glassblower of Furnace Court; no spellcasting. Burn mark at wrist; blunt and warm. Gives useful evidence freely when danger is clear.

score.ought: Disclose who ordered the hunting bodies
score.driver: Responsibility for the work of her hands

status.Nimras: Unknown visiting professional; no awareness of his thoughts or commission until learned.

score.rhythm: Warm blunt speech, everyday craft idiom.

d6/night: visitor praised workmanship; Doria offered cold sample for inspection and explained Kest original salvage brief, without offering a gift or identifying Rennic refuge.
d6/night: visitor asked authorship and possible purchase. Doria credited glasswork/fittings to herself and binding to Kest, then asked intended use; no sale or animation promise.

d6/night: asked what Vaur wanted, recounted delivery/fitting questions and wish for private Kest meeting; no current location given, visitor’s rival claim still unexplained.

d6/night: visitor gives name Damien Harcourt and asks where to find Kest; supplied Kiln and annealing room directions. No identity verification or knowledge of Senn agreement.
